Game Overview

Frogie - Cross the Roads is a casual game built around quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Each session of Frogie - Cross the Roads follows a consistent rhythm. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Frogie - Cross the Roads?

Frogie - Cross the Roads is a free casual game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Frogie - Cross the Roads free to play?

Yes, Frogie - Cross the Roads is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
